_comment: Published list prices, USD per million tokens. Used only to turn a token count into a dollar figure — the token counts themselves come from the provider's usage field and never from this file. If your contract rate differs, edit it here; the percentage saved does not change.

cache._comment: Multipliers on the model's input rate. A cache write costs more than a fresh read of the same bytes; a cache read costs far less. Overridden per model where the provider publishes a flat rate.
